question: What can I expect from my free online consultation?
answer: During your 30-minute video consultation, your certified Skin Expert will assess your skin, discuss your concerns and goals, and create a personalised treatment plan tailored specifically to you. You’ll also receive guidance on which medical-grade products will help achieve the best results.

question: Are the products safe and effective?
answer: Absolutely. All our products are medical-grade, clinically tested, and trusted by dermatologists and skincare professionals worldwide. We carefully select only brands that deliver proven results while meeting the highest safety standards.

question: How soon will I see results?
answer: Results vary depending on your skin type and the products or treatments recommended, but most clients start noticing improvements within a few weeks. Your Skin Expert will monitor your progress and adjust your routine as needed to maximise results.

question: Why can't I buy prescription medical skincare directly online?
answer: Certain medical-grade skincare brands, such as ZO® Skin Health and Obagi Medical, prohibit official stockists from selling prescription-only formulas without prior clinical qualification. This UK regulation protects your skin barrier by ensuring that potent active ingredients (like clinical retinoids, hydroquinone alternatives, and chemical exfoliants) are properly prescribed for your specific condition. Consultations with our clinic are 100% free.

question: Can I contact a Skin Expert if I have questions after my consultation?
answer: Yes! Our certified Skin Experts are always available to answer your questions, guide you through your daily routine, and adjust your treatment plan as needed to ensure the best possible results. You can message Roslyn Bolton directly via WhatsApp or email whenever you need clinical assistance.
